content:
200 Returned if the Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully generated the linking key.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The linking key for the OT connector. You can generate the required
linking key with the Create linking key endpoint.
string
The target site for the OT connector. The target site value is returned
when you generate a linking key with the Create linking key endpoint.
— 400 Returned if the provided type is invalid or missing.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to create a linking key.
500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an error while attempting to create the
linking key.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code.
string
The HTTP status text.
string
A brief message describing the error Tenable Vulnerability Management
encountered.
